Amy K.: Hey team — quick non-work announcement: two things at once — I got promoted to Senior PM 🎉 and Omar and I just put a deposit on a tiny patio house in the East Bay. Sorry for the double celebration spam :party:

Omar H.: WHAT!! Amazing Amy!!! :tada: We should celebrate properly. Office potluck Friday or casual backyard BBQ next weekend? 🥳

Priya: Huge congrats!!! So proud :heart: Potluck sounds easy — I can bring mini pavlovas.

Luis: Promo + house. Legendary. Count me in for anything. :rocket: 

Jenna: Gift idea: plants or wine? @People-Ops — is there a small budget for surprises? :thinking:

Maya: Plants + welcome mat vote from me. Amy, if you have a registry or a short wishlist drop it here so people can chip in.

Amy K.: Thanks all ❤️ No formal registry, but I made a tiny wishlist for practical things and a gift-card option: https://example.com/amy-house-wishlist — totally optional, no pressure. :)

Sam: Quick straw poll (reply with number): 1) Cake 2) Cookies 3) Margaritas• 1 — 6• 2 — 3• 3 — 8  (margaritas leading)

giphy-bot: *posts celebratory confetti gif*

Priya: Margaritas + quick cake works for me. Also, can we do a 15-min cake/announcement after Friday standup? :calendar:

Omar H.: Works. I’ll coordinate snacks & ping facilities about cups/plates. Also Amy — promo lunch on me next week, pick a date.

Amy K.: You all are the best. Thanks for the love. Friday after standup sounds perfect. :blush:

Luis: Added a :confetti_ball: reaction. Congrats again!!

Jenna: I ordered a small snake plant for the house — arriving next week. :seedling:

Sam: RSVP quick check for Friday 3pm mini-celebration: @Amy K., @Omar H., @Priya, @Luis, @Jenna, @Maya, @Sam

Amy K.: See you Friday! 

End of thread.
